BiblicalUsage: The word names the crushed and the oppressed, the people the world steps on. The psalms call the Lord a refuge for the oppressed, and promise that He will judge the fatherless and the oppressed so that the man of the earth may oppress no more. Proverbs warns that a lying tongue hates those it has afflicted, and the oppressed are not to return ashamed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God has a special care for the crushed. When the world grinds people down, the Lord lifts them up, and that is why the poor and needy can praise His name.
